selection: All expanded unit identities from parser, namespace, XML descriptor and OPC XML tests. No BDD scenario directly exercises the low-level XML codec; all 973 presentation/model BDD scenarios retain their exact rows and deferred feature obligations in test-case-map.json. Passing this dependency promotes none of them.

language_security.J09: Internal QName records and immutable element arrays, scoped to one admitted XML part; foreign/stale snapshot handles are rejected. Not the public owned model XmlNode/part API. No XPath/evaluation, runtime parser callbacks, ambient host I/O or network.
language_security.whitespace: Deliberate F04 difference: retain all original whitespace instead of the source parser stripping inter-element text.
language_security.bytes: Explicit Uint8Array input only; UTF-8/UTF-16 XML 1.0, same byte order/BOM after edits. Source Unicode/string overload is explicitly mapped to caller encoding, not implicit paths.
language_security.entities: DTD declarations and custom entities prohibited. XML predefined escapes and numeric character references are parsed normally; no entity fetch/expansion capability.
language_security.merge: QName-based attribute string/null merge and declared ordered singleton-child upsert/remove. Repeated/ambiguous declared slots fail. Unknown siblings, attributes, comments, PIs, CDATA and whitespace retain their exact source spans.
language_security.limits: Explicit part bytes, element/text/CDATA/comment/PI nodes, depth and one edit-work budget. Iterative edit traversal rejects cycles; output re-admitted before return. Whole-deck asynchronous scheduling/aggregate resource charging remains the operation layer responsibility.
